history.summary: A 2,220 sqft penthouse listed under a generic 'Freehold Penthouse' name with no identifiable project, no built_year and zero URA data — the dossier cannot establish appreciation, comps or liquidity. The $1,140 psf looks cheap only because penthouse void/roof area is included; the $2.53M quantum is a thin-pool penthouse, the hardest sub-segment to exit.
history.rating_rationale: Unidentifiable project with no URA appreciation, no median PSF and missing built_year — there is no verifiable investment case. Penthouses are the most illiquid format, optically-low PSF is inflated by non-living area, and $2.53M sits above the deep buyer band. As an investment this is uninvestable on the data given.
red_flags: No project identity, no built_year, no URA appreciation/median/txn data
Penthouse — thinnest resale pool, hardest exit
Low PSF distorted by large void/roof terrace area
catalysts: Freehold tenure in D15 East Coast
